login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: The studio’s production system: projects, tasks, deadlines.
login.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
login.quote: Full visibility of production — from the project down to the last approved version of a shot.

code.title: Confirm your email
code.subtitle: First sign-in: prove that the address is yours.
code.sentTo: We sent a six-digit code to {email}. It is valid for 15 minutes.
code.label: Code from the email
code.resent: A new code was sent to {email}
code.verifyFailed: Could not confirm the code. Please try again.
code.resendFailed: Could not send the code. Please try again.
code.changedSubtitle: The administrator changed your sign-in address. Confirm that you now sign in with it.
code.changedSentTo: Your sign-in address is now {email}. We sent a six-digit code to it; it is valid for 15 minutes.
code.changedSubmit: Confirm the new email and sign in

forgot.title: Password recovery
forgot.intro: Enter your work email and we will send you a link to reset the password.
forgot.sent: If this address is registered, we have sent it an email with a link to reset the password.
forgot.sentHint: The link is valid for 60 minutes. The email may take a few minutes to arrive — check the Spam folder too.
forgot.failed: Could not send the request. Please try again.

reset.title: New password
reset.intro: Choose a new password to sign in with.
reset.hint: At least {min} characters. Length matters more than symbols: a phrase of several words is stronger than a short complex password.
reset.tooShort: The password is shorter than {min} characters
reset.failed: Could not change the password. Please try again.
reset.done: Now sign in with the new password. All previous sessions have been signed out and a confirmation was emailed to you.
reset.invalid: This password reset link is invalid or has already been used.
reset.missingToken: The link has no reset code. Open the full link from the email or request a new one.

setPassword.title: Set your own password
setPassword.intro: You signed in with a password the administrator set. Replace it with your own — the workspace opens after that.
setPassword.failed: Could not save the password. Please try again.
